programme.desc: S01 E02 — Ghosts in the Gathering Rooms The five remaining designers divide into teams to revive Bihl Manor's living room and parlor; as ambitious feature projects test their skills, they'll fight to honor the home's storied past and avoid becoming the next design casualty.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Enter if You Dare Four designers remain in the competition to bring the once-grand Bihl Manor back to life; split into two teams, they'll revive the haunted halls on the first and second floors, but will the spirits and judges approve?
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S03 E02 — The Bold and the Bunker Jack McBrayer is back on the hunt to find wild homes!; his journey takes him to resurrected ruins of a desert ghost town, a concrete castle in the mountains, and a home that's mostly black and white.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E13 — Large and In Charge Jack explores an aviation-inspired home built on a lot previously leveled by wildfire; after an update about a successful wild home sale, Jack goes south to visit a replica of the White House.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E12 — Sleigh All Day Jack visits an old flour mill that's been restored into a private residence; he also gets into the holiday spirit by touring a Christmas-themed log cabin and exploring a replica of the Palace of Versailles.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E14 — Enchanted Forest Jack sets off on a wanderlust adventure touring forest hideaways, and first is a family's fairytale cottage; then, he visits a husband's dream home for his wife and a property that's an ever-evolving, livable artwork.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E16 — Strap In for Fun Jack heads to New York and tours a Manhattan townhouse with a big rock climbing wall; and after an update from a Palm Springs palace he toured in the past, he checks out a California home that invites bold exploration.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E15 — Rock Out Jack's wild adventures continue as he tours a townhome that's a love letter to Asheville, N.C.; he visits a crisp multi-dome that can withstand a natural disaster and tours a desert home that's carved into a mountain's natural bedrock.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Horror in the Ominous Ozarks Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Ominous Ozarks where three homes duke it out for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a home of devilish doppelgängers and a ghostly gangster meeting place.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S03 E03 — The Eeriest of the East Retta's journey to find scary takes her to the Eerie East where four homes vie for a chance at a $150,000 makeover by designer Alison Victoria! It includes a ghoulish home overrun with ghosts and a Victorian infested with spiders and apparitions.
programme.title: Scariest House in America

programme.desc: S274 E09 — Room for His Ego A couple searches for a home big enough for themselves, their two kids, her mom and his big ego in Atlanta; they need an in-law suite for her mom, and he wants something modern and turnkey, but she prefers a place with more character.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S278 E09 — Analysis Paralysis A 20-something is ready to leave her parents' home and find her own place in the Seattle area; she's toured 170 properties and still can't decide what will work best for her, but with a tight budget, she may need to make some compromises.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S278 E10 — He's Being Too Calm About This After moving into a home that they built, a Massachusetts couple finds that it's too small for their family; he's willing to take on a renovation project to get the house that they need, but she's worried about another costly construction disaster.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: Fixers are Triggering After a bad experience with a fixer years ago, a couple's back in the market for a home in the North Dallas suburbs; she wants to try it again with something low-priced that she can make into her dream home, but he prefers modern and move-in ready.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S276 E05 — Tag Teaming for a Cattery A hardworking couple seeks a slower pace and looks to relocate from Pennsylvania to Mississippi; they need enough space for her parents, four dogs, 18 chickens, and seven Maine Coon cats, but agreeing on a location may be a challenge.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S271 E45 — Historic vs. New in New Jersey Buyers with three pets are leaving their cramped apartment in Midtown Manhattan for more space in the New Jersey suburbs; one wants a charming old Victorian with lots of original details, but the other's hoping for something brand new and modern.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S279 E11 — Rushing Into Things A couple engaged after 44 days looks to buy a beach house for themselves and their two daughters on Florida's Emerald Coast. She has high expectations for luxury living and is willing to pay for it, but he's more frugal and prefers to spend less.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: That's Amore in Pennsylvania A girl and a guy disagree on what to buy in Pennsylvania; a first-generation Italian-American wife doesn't mind spending for a turnkey home in a great location, but her frugal Portuguese-American husband prefers to buy low and renovate.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.title: House Hunters
